svg.aria-label: integrix on the GeoStack role ladder: run and the checkpointed and truncated scans as algorithms; the split-explicit terms, beside diffrax's terms, as the model; adaptive rules, diffrax solvers, steppers, IMEX schemes and adjoint options as strategies; sums, running integrals, expectations, weight diagnostics and step functions as primitives; and the results with functax's rules as structures; diffrax, optimistix and lineax and the setup names sit beside the ladder.
